newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's ICA wins subway contract.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's ICA wins subway contract.

text.p: Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora, Mexico's largest construction firm, said Thursday that it had won the contract to refurbish the Line 2 railways of the Mexico City Metro, or subway, through an international public bid in conjunction with Cogifer T.P. of France.

ICA's portion of the contract is valued at 286 million pesos, ICA said through a news release issued by its New York-based publicity firm. Cogifer T.P.'s portion of the contract is valued at 374 million pesos.

The results of the bidding were announced to the bidders on December 6 by Sistema de Transporte Colectivo, the company in charge of operating the Metro. The contract, signed on December 10, has a total value of 660 million pesos.
